justification: Four logical portfolio attempts per 15-minute tick reserve at most 80 weights, averaging 5.333 weights/minute; internal HTTP retries remain separately charged by the shared limiter telemetry. One slot is reserved for never-observed candidates, one for due retries, and two for due refreshes; unused slots are immediately lent to the other lanes. Within discovery, the least recently examined candidate progresses first (initially oldest added); retries progress by oldest last attempt; refreshes progress by oldest observation. Deferrals update their examination age, so a protected prefix cannot consume the 80-row scan on every tick. A fixed hash rank cannot reclaim every slot. At most four logical calls occur per tick. Consecutive failures are capped at six; any successful refresh resets the failure count. The existing local limiter remains authoritative; no request bypasses it. No AI budget or RE call is included.
